file: src/api/reports.ts

The issue of the weekly scheduled export not sending the first week, especially depending on the time of day the schedule is created, is likely related to how the firstRunAt date is calculated and how the nextRunAt is set in the report. The code sets nextRunAt upon report creation based on the firstRunAt function, which uses nextRunAt from the scheduler module to compute the first execution time. This calculation might not correctly handle schedules created early on the day of the intended export, causing the first run to be skipped until the next week. Investigating and adjusting the scheduling logic and timing calculations in src/api/reports.ts, particularly around firstRunAt and nextRunAt, should help resolve this bug.

input.title: Fix scheduled exports to send initial export on creation day
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The firstRunAt function uses nextRunAt with the schedule cadence and the current time to determine the next run time for sending scheduled exports. However, if a weekly schedule is created early in the day, it might compute the next run time to be the next week instead of the same day, causing the first scheduled export email to be skipped on creation day.

This pull request proposes investigating and correcting the logic in firstRunAt or nextRunAt usage to ensure that when a weekly schedule is created, the first export is properly scheduled to be sent the same day if applicable, fixing the issue where the first weekly export is sent only a week later.
